card.text: M23 is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 713 parsecs away.

sources.label: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), NGC_6494: dist50, the median of the maximum-likelihood distance, 713.40536845 pc (16th to 84th percentile 713 to 714)
Wikipedia, "Messier 23"
sources.quote: Messier 23, also known as NGC 6494, is an open cluster of stars in the northwest of the southern constellation of Sagittarius.

introduction.text: M23 is drawn as 663 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
